about: Steven N. Berger attended law school and graduated from The University of Arizona James E. Rogers College of Law in 1984. Steven Berger began practicing law in 1984.
Steven Berger is an attorney at Engelman Berger PC, helping people with Bankruptcy: Business issues. Engelman Berger PC has an office in Phoenix, Arizona, serving the local community.

Steven Berger was selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
